reference.sources: prototypes/rose-hifi/src (oxblood.css final passes 337-534, style.css, app.js, views.js, icons.js, assets/oxblood-home.svg, assets/oxblood-rose.svg)

ownership.writer: Agent Product/Home (workspace/rose-agent). Single writer of this file; OS Product reads it key-for-key and requests changes on #410.
ownership.agentProduct: Home, icons/folder, Rose conversation, Background Work manager, Rose Agent's pearl renderer.
ownership.osProduct: System switcher and its two carousels, bottom-edge gesture, raised edge (peek), live vertical resize, insets, OS-wide microphone integration. Launcher3/SystemUI implement these values in their own renderer.

units: Lengths in dp (the prototype's CSS px on its 384x832 screen map 1:1 to dp). Colours are ARGB hex (0xAARRGGBB as #AARRGGBB). Durations in ms. Easing as cubic-bezier control points.

home.placement: scale = max(W/390, H/844); centred horizontally; top-aligned

rose.placement: scale = max(W/390, H/844); centred horizontally; top-aligned
rose.use: Rose conversation, Background Work, app window views, and the switcher

fields.notes: Procedural vector artwork; no raster, grain or blue. SVG gradients are in each shape's objectBoundingBox. Blurs: beam soft stdDeviation 2.5, join bloom 9, rose lit-join soft 3.

ruby.gradient: radial, circle centred at (34%, 28%), radius = distance to the farthest corner

silver.when: microphone muted (only where a real mute state exists)

speakingBreath.reducedMotion: static at the 'from' values (agreed deviation: the reference drops the ring entirely, which hides speaking)

pearl.connectingCue: none on the pearl; the caption carries it

homeEdge.outline: M0,0 arc r34 (centre 34,0) to 34,34; L W-34,34; arc r34 (centre W-34,0) to W,0; L W,H; L 0,H; Z
homeEdge.extendsBelowFor: the tappable navigation inset (three-button navigation); gesture navigation adds nothing

hairline.along: the concave contour (y = 34 and both fillets)

controls.layout: centred row, gap 14, vertically centred in the flat area (centre 29dp above the edge bottom)

microphone.status: Rose Agent's own microphone-input mute (#410 wave item 6; Nathan's correction): shipped on Home; the raised edge (OS Product) shows and controls the same state. Never OS-wide: not Sensor Privacy or AudioManager microphone mute.

roseMicInput.meaning: whether microphone input into Rose Agent is withheld; unmute restores it. Never Rose's output, other apps' audio, Sensor Privacy or AudioManager microphone mute; never starts, ends or stops a call, task or session
roseMicInput.shown: the live call's own input mute while a call is live and connected (VoiceService.muted), otherwise the shared state (RoseMicInput.shown)
roseMicInput.store: Rose's private preferences rose-mic-input/muted, default false; a new call, reconnect or replaced renderer starts from it
roseMicInput.backend: App Core (VoiceService, voice page, voice-providers, LocalRoseLink): reads the store at every call start and reconnect; writes it only for tray_mute/tray_unmute (any origin) and for a page-originated change acknowledged while live and connected; never for a reset (call end, cleanup, renderer loss, connecting); a muted start disables the mic from its first frame; input mute never gates Rose's output
roseMicInput.systemRoute: AgentTrayService protocol v1: STATE.muted is this shown state; MUTE=4/UNMUTE=5 set it (idle: recorded only, voice is never started). Caller check unchanged: platform SystemUI only; any new trusted caller needs review (#410)

homeGrid.verticalBand: superseded by the owner's density correction (#410 comment 6592423187): every page fills its safe area with rows, top-anchored (app pages at the page top, Home 24dp below the date's line), down to 64dp above the edge top (clear of the dots); rows at least rowGap apart, spare height shared up to 32dp per gap; no row cap; Home is four across on phones and up to eight 60dp columns on wide screens; the app pages continue the inventory after Home with no app repeated

workButton.glyph: 2x2 panes of 8dp, gap 4, radius 2, 1.5dp white outline

working.when: at least one authoritatively running Rose session (controller session status exactly "ready"; never launching, starting, scheduled, blocked, consent_required, cleanup_failed, an unknown status)

runningEdge.when: authoritatively running only: the app's controller session status exactly "ready"; never launching, starting, scheduled, blocked, consent_required, cleanup_failed, an unknown status, an unbound or lingering app, or a Stop in flight

motion.reducedMotion: system animator scale 0 (or prefers-reduced-motion): every transition is instant, loops stop at their static frame (running edge at 40deg, pearl breath at its 'from' ring); state stays visible.

switcher.source: views.js:224-249 (fan, snap), oxblood.css:423,442-455 (rows, cards, pearl). Added at OS Product's request (#410); the values were already pinned in Launcher3's RoseFanTest

field.placement: as fields.rose: cover, centred across, top-aligned

fan.offset: k = (card centre - row centre) / card width, clamped to [-1.4, 1.4]
fan.transform: perspective(760) translateX(-k * shift) rotateY(-k * turnDeg) scale(1 - min(1, |k|) * shrink)

card.footer: none: no Stop in the switcher's Rose row

rose.initialCard: the second card when there are three or more

snap.behaviour: scroll to the nearest card centre
snap.note: the reference uses the browser's smooth scroll (650ms instant fallback); native uses the platform's smooth scroll, a declared deviation

notShipped: Global/OS-wide microphone control and its silver-pearl meaning beyond Rose's own call mute (no platform API)
Glass sheen overlay and backdrop blurs
Prototype fixtures: eight windows, three tasks, sample apps, messages, simulated microphone
